headline: Emirates NBA Cup: Tatum erupts for 41 and George adds 28 as Celtics pull away from Wizards 131-116
whyCareReason: Boston scores 80 first-half points behind Jayson Tatum (41) and Paul George (28) to overwhelm Anthony Davis (33/13) and Washington before the Thanksgiving break.
teaser: Jayson Tatum pours in 41 points with 8 assists and Paul George shoots 6-of-9 from deep (28 pts) as the Celtics down the Wizards 131-116 in Washington.
story:
The Boston Celtics produced a blistering first-half at Capital One Arena on Tuesday night, 24 November, defeating the Washington Wizards 131-116 in Emirates NBA Cup group action.

Boston piled up 80 points before halftime (34-28 Q1, 46-21 Q2) behind Jayson Tatum, who finished with 41 points, six rebounds, and eight assists. Paul George added 28 points and nine assists.

Washington mounted a 40-point third quarter behind Anthony Davis (33 points, 13 rebounds) and Trae Young (12 assists), yet could not close the gap. Elsewhere Tuesday, Dallas beat Denver 120-101 behind Cooper Flagg (24 points, 6 rebounds, 12 assists) and Detroit beat Orlando 104-86, Isaiah Joe scoring 21.
stakes: Boston locks down crucial Emirates NBA Cup point differential ahead of Thursday league-wide Thanksgiving pause.
rivalryAngle: Tatum and George outgunned the Wizards trio of Davis, Dybantsa, and Young in an electric 247-point NBA Cup showcase.
funFacts: Boston erupted for 46 second-quarter points to build an 80-49 halftime lead in Washington.
Jayson Tatum finished 41 points, 6 rebounds, and 8 assists; Paul George had 28 points and 9 assists.
Same night in Denver: Cooper Flagg posted 24 points, 6 rebounds, and 12 assists in Dallas 120-101 victory.
